_meta.source: Even Hospitals Billing Manual + Tariff List - Room Rent (Billing Guidelines & Policies), TARIFF 2025-26, effective 1 June 2025.
_meta.purpose: Deterministic billing-integrity rules for a future bill/invoice audit (new doc type). Each rule is checkable against an itemized bill; some also inform the case-audit's value reasoning.

rules.rule: Primary/treating consultant may charge a maximum of 2 visits per day (per consultant in individual practice, or per specialty in group practice).
A referred consultant may charge only 1 visit/day, unless the case is declared multi-specialty clinical management with GM/CMS information.
rules.flagIf: referred consultant billed >1 visit/day without multi-specialty declaration

rules.rule: More than 4 consultations per day in the ward (or ICU) is subject to audit.
Follow-up visits within 7 days of the initial visit are free of consultation charges.
rules.flagIf: consultation charged for a follow-up within 7 days

rules.rule: If two or more consultants see the patient for a single disease, only one consultation fee is payable.
rules.flagIf: multiple consult fees for one disease/specialty

rules.rule: Inpatient consultation fees are uniform across ICU/NICU/HDU/PICU (except wards); ICU consult includes the critical-care team, max 2 visits/day.
One-time registration fee; waived if already registered in another group hospital, and for health check-ups.
rules.flagIf: registration charged for an already-registered or health-check patient

rules.rule: Room billing is a 24-hour cycle (00:00–23:59) from admission. Discharge by 11:00; 11:00–17:00 adds half-day; after 18:00 a full day; 0–3 h stay = half day.
rules.flagIf: room-days billed inconsistent with admit/discharge timestamps

rules.rule: Charges follow the admitted bed category (or higher if upgraded/transferred). Investigations, procedures, packages and consults are all charged differentially by room category.
rules.flagIf: tier charged higher than the admitted category without a documented upgrade

rules.rule: If stepped down from ICU after 12:00 noon, ICU charges for the full day apply.
rules.flagIf: ICU full-day not applied on a post-noon step-down (or applied on a pre-noon step-down)

rules.rule: Day care = a 4-hour slot, max 12 hours; an overnight day-care stay is billed at the relevant room category.
rules.flagIf: day-care billed for a >12 h or overnight stay

rules.rule: Package covers routine related investigations, room rent, surgeon/anaesthetist/assistant fees, OT, doctor visits, medicines and consumables within the package period.
rules.flagIf: an included item billed separately within the package period

rules.rule: Excluded: pre-op profiles; high-end medicines/lasers/implants; outsourced CT/MRI/PET/Doppler/USG; dialysis/blood/IABP/ECMO; cross-referrals; any stay beyond the package period (billed on actuals).
rules.flagIf: an excluded item folded into the package, or stay beyond period not billed on actuals

rules.rule: Two surgeries same sitting: higher 100% + lower 60%. Surgery+procedure same sitting: both 100%. Different regions same sitting: both 100%.
rules.flagIf: multiple-package billing not following the 100/60 or 100/100 rule

rules.rule: No separate invoice is issued for implants.
Open billing: levels of surgery contain only professional surgeon fees; co-surgeon 50%, anaesthesia 30%, assistant 30%, OT 100% of surgeon fee; investigations/room/consumables/implants at actuals.
High-risk: +15% on professional charges (surgeon+assistant+anaesthetist), only if prior consent documented; >2 procedures → 15% on total professional charges.

Emergency (holidays, or 21:00–08:00 weekdays): +20% on surgeon/assistant/anaesthetist + 20% on OT. High-risk AND emergency: +30% on professional + OT charges; all such cases highlighted in EMRD notes and audited.
rules.flagIf: emergency surcharge applied outside emergency hours/holidays

rules.rule: Published tariff is exclusive of GST and government levies; government-regulated tests charged per prevailing notifications.
rules.flagIf: GST folded into the quoted tariff
